title: Editor asks Avi Loeb to cut alien paragraph from 3I/ATLAS paper
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Editor asks Avi Loeb to cut alien paragraph from 3I/ATLAS paper, about 2025 at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he said, he was telling this on a Zoom meeting. The journal editor goes, "Okay, this is a great paper, but you have to take out the final paragraph."

plain: A researcher named Michael Shermer, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on something another researcher, Avi Loeb, said on a Zoom call. Loeb had written a paper in 2025 about 3I/ATLAS, an object passing through from outside our solar system, and according to Shermer the journal editor told him it was a great paper but he had to take out the final paragraph, the one raising the idea of aliens. Told this way, it shows how hard it can be to get the alien question into a science journal.
